patterns.note: Content sections frequently alternate between full-width blocks and two-column layouts, often pairing large, aspirational imagery with concise text blocks.
Elegant serif headings (Cormorant) are used for primary titles, creating a luxurious feel, contrasted with clean, readable sans-serif (Mont) for body text and functional elements.
A sophisticated palette of deep forest green and warm off-whites dominates, providing a natural and refined backdrop for product photography and accentuating key calls to action.
The header is sticky and transforms on scroll, transitioning from a transparent overlay with white text over the hero video to an opaque light background with dark text and a slightly reduced height.
The homepage features prominent editorial-style content blocks that integrate large, high-quality lifestyle photography with descriptive text, enhancing brand storytelling.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-bleed hero section with a looping video background, over which primary messaging and navigation are overlaid. This creates an immediate immersive and dynamic introduction.

A sticky navigation bar is implemented that dynamically changes its appearance upon scroll: initially transparent over the hero, it shrinks slightly and gains a solid light background and dark text as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections are structured to balance large, impactful imagery with textual information, often using a split-screen approach where one side features a compelling photograph and the other provides concise details or calls to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous letter spacing, paired with a clean sans-serif for body copy and smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on buttons and image containers, almost sharp edges).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous padding and margins throughout, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, contributing to an uncluttered and luxurious feel).

standout: This site distinguishes itself through its sophisticated, editorial aesthetic, driven by exceptional lifestyle photography and elegant serif typography. The seamless integration of a full-bleed hero video and the prominent emphasis on the brand's B Corp certification create a distinctive, trustworthy, and aspirational feel that elevates it beyond typical product showcases.
